concern: دیں (banaa dein, "turned into") is romanised "din", which reads as "din" (day). Same collision as the owner's Q21 ruling at 45:17 (daleelein dein); the past-tense verb دیں should be "dein", not "din".
suggestion: Phir nutfa ko hum ne jama hua khoon bana diya, phir is khoon ke lothde ko gosht ka tukda kar diya. Phir gosht ke tukde ko haddiyan bana dein, phir haddiyon ko hum ne gosht pehna diya, phir doosri banaawat mein is ko paida kar diya. Barkaton wala hai woh Allah jo sab se behtareen paida karne wala hai.
